authors: Python Software Foundation, Astral Software Inc. (python-build-standalone)
description: Pre-built CPython native binaries from python-build-standalone (install_only_stripped). Supports Windows (x64, arm64), macOS (x64, arm64), and Linux (x64, arm64). The python distribution is automatically copied to the runtimes/{rid}/python-native directory during build, and the bundled PythonCli helpers locate it, fix its execute permission and run scripts or eval snippets with redirected stdin/stdout/stderr.
title: Python Native Binary
